honest_verdict: In A-shares, after dropping the illiquid bottom 30%, the three size terciles have NEARLY EQUAL mean factor premia (small 0.48 ~ mid 0.48 > large 0.45): the venue effect is weak once micro-caps are excluded, and the crude dollar-vol size proxy conflates liquidity with volatility. The clean limits-to-arbitrage mechanism evidence is the US side (cn_mechanism.json): the reallocation alpha loads positively on illiquidity (t=4.18) and survives F6+all controls at t=3.81. We report the A-share ladder as-is and do not overclaim it.
